title: Biased or Flawed? Mitigating Stereotypes in Generative Language Models by Addressing Task-Specific Flaws

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on ambiguous and disambiguous reading comprehension contexts using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) dataset, measured via Exact Match Overlap (EMO) and a custom bias reinforcement metric.
